title: On submersions with definite folds of manifolds with boundary into Euclidean spaces
summary: Submersions with definite folds are submersions on manifolds with boundary whose restrictions to the boundary are definite fold maps. In this paper, we study differential-topological properties of manifolds with boundary admitting such maps into Euclidean spaces. When the target is $\mathbb{R}$, we obtain restrictions on the diffeomorphism types of the source manifolds by using results for m-functions.
